requirements.quote: An application protocol can assume that an implementation of QUIC provides an interface that includes the operations described in this section. An implementation designed for use with a specific application protocol might provide only those operations that are used by that protocol.
requirements.condition: For a general-purpose QUIC implementation, or for an implementation designed for a specific application protocol with respect to operations used by that protocol.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an interface containing the applicable connection operations described in this section.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: For an implementation designed for a specific application protocol, omission is permitted only for operations not used by that protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation interface can be inspected to determine whether all applicable operations are exposed and whether any omitted operation is unused by the specific application protocol.

requirements.quote: When implementing the client role, an application protocol can: * open a connection, which begins the exchange described in Section 7;
requirements.condition: When the implementation supports the client role and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an operation to open a connection; invoking it begins the connection exchange.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can invoke the client open operation and observe whether it initiates the connection exchange.

requirements.condition: When implementing the client role, Early Data is available, and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an operation that allows the application protocol to enable Early Data.
requirements.why_checkable: The client-facing interface can be inspected and exercised to verify that Early Data can be enabled when available.

requirements.quote: * be informed when Early Data has been accepted or rejected by a server.
requirements.condition: When implementing the client role, Early Data was attempted, and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Inform the application protocol whether the server accepted or rejected Early Data.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can exercise both server acceptance and rejection and verify that the client application receives the corresponding outcome.

requirements.quote: When implementing the server role, an application protocol can: * listen for incoming connections, which prepares for the exchange described in Section 7;
requirements.condition: When the implementation supports the server role and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an operation to listen for incoming connections; invoking it prepares the server for the connection exchange.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can invoke the listen operation and verify that the server becomes prepared to receive an incoming connection exchange.

requirements.quote: * if Early Data is supported, embed application-controlled data in the TLS resumption ticket sent to the client;
requirements.condition: When implementing the server role, Early Data is supported, and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the application protocol to embed application-controlled data in the TLS resumption ticket sent to the client.
requirements.why_checkable: A server API and emitted resumption ticket can be tested to verify that application-supplied data can be embedded.

requirements.quote: * if Early Data is supported, retrieve application-controlled data from the client's resumption ticket and accept or reject Early Data based on that information.
requirements.condition: When implementing the server role, Early Data is supported, and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the application protocol to retrieve application-controlled data from the client's resumption ticket and use that information to choose whether to accept or reject Early Data.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can supply known ticket data, verify that it is exposed to the application, and confirm that the application's resulting accept-or-reject decision controls Early Data handling.

requirements.quote: In either role, an application protocol can: * configure minimum values for the initial number of permitted streams of each type, as communicated in the transport parameters (Section 7.4);
requirements.condition: When implementing either role and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow configuration of minimum values for the initial number of permitted streams of each stream type, and communicate those values in the transport parameters.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can configure per-type minimum stream counts and inspect the resulting transport parameters to verify that the configured values are communicated.

requirements.quote: * control resource allocation for receive buffers by setting flow control limits both for streams and for the connection;
requirements.condition: When implementing either role and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow receive-buffer resource allocation to be controlled by setting flow-control limits at both the stream level and the connection level.
requirements.why_checkable: The interface can be inspected and exercised to verify independently configurable stream-level and connection-level flow-control limits.

requirements.quote: * identify whether the handshake has completed successfully or is still ongoing;
requirements.condition: When implementing either role and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Expose whether the handshake completed successfully or remains ongoing.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can query or observe the exposed status before and after successful handshake completion and compare it with the actual handshake state.

requirements.quote: * keep a connection from silently closing, by either generating PING frames (Section 19.2) or requesting that the transport send additional frames before the idle timeout expires (Section 10.1);
requirements.condition: When implementing either role, the application requests prevention of silent closure, and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide a means to keep the connection from silently closing by generating PING frames or by requesting transmission of additional frames before the idle timeout expires.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not defer the selected keep-alive transmission until after the idle timeout expires.
requirements.why_checkable: A timed test can request keep-alive behavior and observe a PING or another requested frame before expiration of the idle timeout.

requirements.condition: When implementing either role and this operation is applicable under the interface rule in lines 1578-1582.
requirements.required_behavior: Provide an operation that allows the application protocol to immediately close the connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can invoke the close operation and verify that the connection transitions immediately into closure processing.
